plan: To preserve capital, we will exit all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) as they are below their stops and carry higher risk.
We will also sell all 2x leveraged single names (METU, MUU, PLTU, MSFU) to significantly reduce overall portfolio beta.
QQQI will be trimmed to 20% to cap single name exposure and free up capital.
This strategy aims for a large cash buffer and focuses on income and broad index exposure.
The goal is capital preservation with minimal drawdown.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets approximately 1.5% per month, prioritizing capital preservation. Expect significantly reduced volatility and drawdown potential. Returns will be modest, but the portfolio is better positioned for market downturns.

plan: We will trim SOXL and SPAL to reduce overall leveraged ETF exposure, bringing the combined sleeve within mandate.
Leveraged single names (METU, MUU, PLTU, MSFU) will also be trimmed to reduce concentration and overall portfolio risk.
A new position in ANET will be initiated at 5%, leveraging its strong scanner read and quality tech profile.
This approach balances broad index exposure with quality tech and a small, controlled amount of leverage.
The plan aims for risk-first growth while maintaining a moderate cash buffer.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets approximately 2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns. The portfolio blends broad market exposure with quality tech and controlled leverage for steady growth.

plan: To pursue aggressive growth, we will increase exposure to leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) and leveraged single names (METU, MUU, PLTU, MSFU).
This strategy leans into the current uptrend and uses leverage to amplify potential returns.
A new position in ANET will be initiated at 5%, capitalizing on its strong scanner read.
This plan concentrates in high-scoring setups and utilizes leverage, accepting higher risk for higher potential reward.
Strict stop discipline is crucial to manage the increased drawdown potential.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets approximately 4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. Be aware of significantly higher volatility and drawdown potential, especially with leveraged ETFs. Daily decay and rebalancing can erode gains quickly; strict stop discipline is paramount to manage risk.

plan: To prioritize income, we will sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) and high-beta single names (CRWD, SNOW, SMCI).
SMH will also be sold to reduce exposure to a volatile sector.
QQQI will be increased to 30% to enhance monthly distributions and provide a stable income stream.
This strategy focuses on income-generating ETFs and broad index exposure, minimizing growth-oriented positions.
The goal is low drawdown and reliable income, with a cash buffer.
income.read: This income plan targets approximately 1% per month, prioritizing steady monthly distributions. Expect very low volatility and drawdown potential. While aiming for reliable income, distributions are variable, and NAV can still decline in market selloffs; this is not a savings account.
